gaps.explanation: Statement p6 (governmental funds) Transfers in 171,583 = General Fund 116,858 + Debt Service Fund 54,725; Transfers out (171,507) = Debt Service (78,573) + Other Governmental Funds (92,934). Two parts. (1) Missing lines: the Debt Service budget schedule p15 prints only the net 'Transfers in (out)' (23,848), recorded as detail 145 (-23,848); the Debt Service Fund's gross Transfers in 54,725 is not in detail. Fix: remove detail 145 and add Debt Service Transfers In 54,725 and Transfers Out -78,573 from p6 (54,725 - 78,573 = -23,848, same net). (2) Different basis, 7,150: the General Fund combining schedule p17 records transfers per subfund column (General 474 + Ambulance 23,450 + Pool 90,084 + Library 10,000 in, Parks (7,150) out; net 116,858), while the statement p6 prints the General Fund only net (Transfers in 116,858), so the subfund transfers in are 7,150 higher than the statement's General Fund figure. Check: 124,008 + 54,725 = 178,733 = statement 171,583 + 7,150 intra-General Fund (Parks) transfers that the statement nets; not an error.
